original_test_intent: Verify OAM_3 power consumption is correctly and consistently reported on Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Bind every metric to physical OAM_3 and its measurement boundary, collect synchronized read-only samples under a defined operating point, normalize units/window and compare only equivalent chip/module/rail values against approved ranges and deltas.
manual_activity: Power owner approves OAM_3 chip/module/rail relationships and comparison rules, then judges discrepancies.
required_inputs: OAM_3 identity and per-interface power-channel map
Operating state, units, averaging windows and time limits
Secure BMC/DUT tools and Web view
safety_requirements: Never sum channels without an approved non-overlap map
Stop on domain, status, unit or freshness ambiguity

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Redfish resource may expose OAM_3 power, but unsafe one-source parsing cannot prove domain equivalence or source-required parity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture mapped OAM_3 power channels securely across all interfaces, document chip/module/rail boundaries and compare only approved equivalents in a synchronized operating window.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_3, Redfish/IPMI/ROCm/Web comparison and source timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a boundary-aware table for raw channels and a separately approved derived table for any non-overlapping aggregates, each with time/window/status.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents double counting and false equality between ASIC and whole-module power.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No external-meter or stress validation is added.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If interfaces expose fundamentally different domains, correctness may be presence/range rather than direct numeric equality.

project_override_considerations: Engineering owns the OAM_3 rail topology and whether any IPMI/Redfish channels may be summed or compared to ROCm ASIC power.
expected_evidence: Operating state and synchronized version/time context
Aggregation rationale, logs, dispositions, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently calls for OAM_3 power parity; DeepSeek's reduced command is incomplete, not authoritative conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Power topology, secure tools and user review are supplyable prerequisites.

review_improvement: Introduces boundary-aware comparison and rejects unapproved channel summation for OAM_3 power.
independent_technical_reasoning: ROCm commonly reports ASIC/package power while a controller channel may include memory, regulators or an input rail. Summing overlapping rail sensors can double-count consumption, while comparing ASIC power directly to module input can create a systematic false mismatch. OAM_3 therefore needs an engineering-approved energy boundary for each number before arithmetic or tolerance is applied.
